design.act: build Asset A, the depicted-kind sign classification, once - from held published sources only, entered blind, frozen before any join - then test whether depicted kind discriminates between Hunt's meaning account and the grammar account of the recorded three-part pattern
design.hypothesis: the signs Hunt's model assigns to each part are enriched in that part beyond what position behaviour alone predicts, and the closing part's membership is better predicted by depicted kind than by word-ending behaviour (spec section 1.2; F045-C03, F045-C04)

asset_a.form: one row per sign over the full pinned-crosswalk sign universe (187 distinct registry_sign_id values in 205 crosswalk rows at the freeze census; DD-045-18), in asset-a/depicted-kind-classification.csv with asset-a/asset-a-freeze.json, built at execution step 1 under gates A1 to A6 - NOT built at this freeze
asset_a.fields: spec section 2.2 and no others: sign_key, cisi_no, parpola_no, depicted_kind, depicted_label_verbatim, governing_source, source_citations, agreement, dispute_status, d18_input, entered_blind
asset_a.sources: held published sources only, under the section 2.3 hierarchy (CISI volumes governing; Parpola's published identifications where CISI is silent; Mahadevan and Wells only through a D-18 record)

d18_consumption.form: Spec 046's frozen delivery: concordance-297.json (schema glossa.concordance/1), produced on every terminal outcome, pinned by its own SHA-256 at Asset A's freeze (spec section 2.6; DD-045-17)
d18_consumption.vocabulary: Spec 046's total outcome set, consumed as frozen and not changed: CONSENSUS / PARTIAL CONCURRENCE / SINGLE-SOURCE / CONTESTED, with a closure file on every terminal outcome
d18_consumption.partial_concurrence: consumed as corroboration counting exactly the one independent corroboration it carries, its state recorded verbatim in d18_input, never presented as consensus
d18_consumption.closures: IDENTIFICATION FAILED and CLOSED AT STEP 0 are acceptable terminal deliveries satisfying the input timing rule: the concordance file with an empty signs array plus a closure block; Asset A proceeds without the feed and records its absence
d18_consumption.null_key_disposition: a sign record whose crosswalk_registry_id is null (a lawful Wells-list-entry match under Spec 046 section 6), or does not resolve in the pinned crosswalk, is not rejected: it is recorded in the build record under its Wells-list-entry reference, never re-keyed by hand, attaches to an Asset A row only through a stated linkage to a row blind entry independently entered for the same drawn sign, and otherwise stands recorded as an unattached D-18 input, failing neither gate A2 nor gate A3

producer_digests.note: both quoted as Spec 046's osf-spec-registration.md presents them (DD-045-21): the freeze-act digest is carried in Spec 046's filed OSF registration (https://osf.io/dnts8/); the successor is the value in Spec 046's freeze.json as merged. Neither is Asset A's input pin.

test.fit_form: out-of-sample predictive accuracy - the share of held-out part-membership predictions the model gets right - on the odd/even inscription-ID split (DD-045-11)
test.margin_derivation: the pinned positional record's structural test: initial-strong signs carry a mean initial rate of 0.757 against 0.251 expected by chance, an advantage of 0.506; one tenth of that advantage is 0.0506, frozen as 0.05 (DD-045-11)
test.closing_measure_spec045: the closing distinct-predecessor rate: the rate at which a sign follows many different signs as a final element (distinct predecessors in final position, with its final-position count) - Spec 045's section 5.2(a) measure, under its own frozen name (DD-045-19)
test.closing_measure_spec054: Phase-43 terminal-strong set membership: a set-membership state under the Phase-43 battery - Spec 054's (design D-08's) closing measure, a DIFFERENT measure from Spec 045's; neither spec adopts the other's form and neither spec's output may quote the other's closing result as its own (DD-045-19; Spec 054's freeze will mirror this note at OPEN-054-6)
test.comparison_rule: over every sign in the test population with a recorded positional profile, each closing score is read as a ranking of closing membership and agreement is its AUC against recorded terminal-strong membership; depicted kind predicts better exactly when its AUC is strictly greater; equal AUCs count as suffix-like behaviour predicting at least as well (DD-045-12)
test.jurisdiction_rule: a row is jurisdiction-coded exactly when its depicted_label_verbatim itself names an office, a holder of authority, or a governed place; coding is from the verbatim label alone, at entry, stated per row in the build record before the asset freeze (DD-045-14)
test.verdicts: DISCRIMINATED FOR HUNT / DISCRIMINATED FOR THE GRAMMAR ACCOUNT / NOT DISCRIMINATED, per spec section 5.4, with ASSET FAILED, INVALID, and NOT ADJUDICATED as stop classes

design.coverage_consequence_for_spec050: Spec 050's gate 0.3 corpus-wide coverage assertion rests on this frozen full-universe scope and does not close INVALID for want of corpus-wide coverage on this ground (DD-045-18)
design.spot_check: no second-enterer spot check is added at this freeze, decided on the record (DD-045-16)
design.fences: no gloss is established; depiction is the published identification layer, not ground truth; Spec 037's 49 percent census caution travels with the asset and every verdict; negative, undiscriminated, asset-failed, and not-adjudicated outcomes publish with the same prominence as a discrimination (spec section 8)
design.execution_gate: NOT satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21: the OSF contract registration was filed at the freeze under E-1 and execution awaits its approval plus the campaign execution pass (Wave 3); Asset A does not exist at the freeze and no sign was classified
